video_title: Donovan Mitchell Takes Us Inside Cavaliers Training Camp In Spain 🔥

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the benefits of team bonding in Spain
quotes.excerpt: I think it's something that teams really need and to be able to do out here in Spain
quotes.quote: Being out here really allows you to kind of come together. We're not only home, we don't go 30 minutes each, opposite direction, we're on the same resort. We're flying on the same plane, we're doing all these different things. I think it's something that teams really need and to be able to do out here in Spain, in a different country, for some guys on the team it's the first time being out of the country, which is wild. So just to be able to see that and allow like all those experiences, I think they really go a long way.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the importance of attention to detail
quotes.excerpt: Moving with intention, going about every practice, and understanding that the margin for error is so small.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing I learned I think is the details. Like I said, moving with intention, going about every practice, and understanding that the margin for error is so small. I don't be doing that less in the game.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell's unique leadership ability
quotes.excerpt: He connects players, he connects coaches, he's got a unique leadership ability to connect with everybody.
quotes.quote: He's a great leader. The biggest thing about he connects everybody. He connects players, he connects coaches, he's got a unique leadership ability to connect with everybody, bring everybody together.

quotes.speaker: James Harden
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden on the importance of team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I feel like this group is getting really, really connected, really close together, and that right there is a bonus for us.
quotes.quote: Team bonding, man, is everything. I've been in the league for a long time and just there's there's there's teams where the group was very tight-knit and we were overachieved or we did what we're supposed to do. I feel like this group is getting really, really connected, really close together, and that right there is a bonus for us.

quotes.speaker: Koby Altman
quotes.summary_phrase: Koby Altman on Donovan Mitchell's impact and commitment to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: He ignites all of us in terms of his work ethic, in terms of his attitude.
quotes.quote: Donovan is such a tremendous leader for us and a great partner. He's fantastic. He's just a great person to be around. He ignites all of us in terms of his work ethic, in terms of his attitude, and the fact that he really wants to be in Cleveland, Ohio. Getting to his first conference finals last year, he wants more, and I think we're going to help him get there.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on his goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Making the conference finals for my first time and in nine in my whole career, obviously it's a step in the right direction.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing for myself is continue to be a good leader. Making the conference finals for my first time and in nine in my whole career, obviously it's a step in the right direction. So double down on the on the habits, understanding the details are so small, the margins are so small, and really paying attention to every little thing, every little rebound, defensive stop, turnover, shot, anything. I think that's what's next for myself and the group.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on Donovan Mitchell's growth as a leader
quotes.excerpt: I think he's taking steps, major steps ahead in leadership, you know, being a just great character to be around.
quotes.quote: I think he's taking steps, major steps ahead in leadership, you know, being a just great character to be around. Because these type of players at some point you just don't you just stop measuring them by their scoring ability, by their basketball ability. So him being here for me means a lot, so just seeing him growing still and becoming one of the greats in our game is just special for me because I know what type of player he is and I know what type of character he is.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Donovan Mitchell's leadership and communication
quotes.excerpt: He's already a great leader, but this year he's just taking it up communicating with everybody including the coaches.
quotes.quote: He's stepping up in mid-flight. Almost every play he has something positive to say or something that needs to be fixed. He wants to see everybody succeed. I mean he's already a great leader, but this year he's just taking it up communicating with everybody including the coaches.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on integrating new players into the team
quotes.excerpt: I think you're starting to see them kind of get integrated what we're doing and having a full camp with James.
quotes.quote: I think it's something that we're starting to put the pieces together. We're kind of putting the base of what we do together. Adding new guys, Mario, P-Wat, Malik, right? I think you're starting to see them kind of get integrated what we're doing and having a full camp with James obviously always helps just because being able to teach and learn and understand habits and build off of last postseason and get ready for the year.
